title: Interview Session Record
description: One stored interview session, as recorded in the append-only session index when the open exchange file is closed and moved. Written by the store tool: id, opened and closed come from the session file and the clock; about, tags and prior are the interviewee's closing note. Nothing here is a count of the file's contents — those are read from the file.

id.description: The session id: the first record's timestamp as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ. Equal to the session field stamped on every record in the file, and to the stored file's name stem.

opened.description: Timestamp of the first record, ISO 8601 Zulu.

closed.description: Time the session was stored, ISO 8601 Zulu.

about.description: What the conversation turned out to be about, in the interviewee's words, given at close. Not read by any categorizer.

tags.description: The interviewee's own closing tags, slugs. Not read by any categorizer.

prior.description: Session ids this session continues from, as named at close.
